## LEARNING - Generate Quiz (RFC-022)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/learning-generate-quiz

**Parameters:**
- `lesson_id` (required): UUID of the lesson
- `guild_id` (required): Discord guild ID
- `topic` or `content` (required): Quiz topic or lesson content
- `num_questions` (optional): Number of questions (default: 10)
- `question_types` (optional): [mcq, true_false, open] (default: [mcq, true_false])
- `difficulty` (optional): easy | medium | hard (default: medium)
- `language` (optional): fr | en (default: fr)
- `time_limit_seconds` (optional): Quiz time limit (default: 600)
- `passing_score` (optional): Minimum score to pass (default: 70)
- `adaptive` (optional): Enable adaptive mode (default: false)

**Returns:** Quiz with generated questions saved to API
